$description: Orrery core scales: shared by every brand. Values that a brand may not change live here.

testData.$description: Phase 0 test data for the Swift output, not a token decision: Iris's DEFAULT_OPEN_SPRING from src/motion.ts.

spacing.$description: Ten steps on a 4px base, then layout widths.

space-4.$description: Hairline gaps: ramp swatch gap, chip vertical padding, icon-to-text.

space-8.$description: Tight gaps: chip horizontal padding, label-to-content, list item gap.

space-12.$description: Row padding in dense lists and tables; card grid gap on mobile.

space-16.$description: Default component gap; row padding; page gutter under 600px.

space-20.$description: Sheet padding on mobile; gap between index cards.

space-24.$description: Gap between stacked sheets; row padding in decision lists; sheet padding in rail.

space-32.$description: Gap between sections in memo mode; sheet padding on desktop.

space-40.$description: Large sheet padding (answer sheet, twin sheets) on desktop.

space-48.$description: Space above a page title; between major blocks in report mode.

space-72.$description: Section rhythm in report and poster modes; page bottom padding.

layout-measure.$description: Max line length for prose blocks in every mode (about 68 characters; em so it tracks the block's own size).

layout-read.$description: Container width for memo mode (single reading column).

layout-report.$description: Container width for rail (default) and report modes.

layout-gutter.$description: Page side padding at 860px and up; `space-32` from 600px; `space-16` below.

layout-rail.$description: Sticky question column in report mode; side table of contents.

layout-label.$description: Label column in a label | body strip row and the memo key-value head; collapses above the body under 600px.

radius.$description: Two radii do the work: 10 for layers, 6 for what sits inside them. Nothing larger than 12px.

radius-panel.$description: Layer-1 surfaces: sheets, panels, cards, index cards, segmented-control track. Nothing larger than 12px anywhere.

radius-control.$description: Layer-2 and controls: chips, insets, inputs, buttons, ramp swatches, segment thumbs. A 10px container with 4px padding holds 6px children.

radius-round.$description: True circles only: dots and discs. Never pills on text chips.

shadow.$description: One faint shadow per page, never in dark.

shadow-lift.$description: The page's one shadow, via `.os-lift` on the decisions sheet. Dark theme: none (no glows).

border.$description: Stroke widths. Colors come from `line`, `line-strong`, `line-dashed`, `text` and `accent`.

line-width.$description: Every hairline and rule: layer borders, row dividers, `line-strong` rules, dashed absent-item borders, the gap between panel cells.

ring-width.$description: Keyboard focus ring: a solid `accent` outline at this width on every focusable element.

size.$description: Font-size steps. Type roles pick from these.
